purpose: Minimize compact serialized physical MHA parameter payload while retaining per-head Attention function; independent diagnostic follow-up to earlier MA-1162 multihead aligned synthetic experiment
old_result_policy: Previously opened MA-1162 worlds 16101/16102/16103 are not reused or pooled. 16110 development world was used to select only the global 12-bit View code / FP16 base reference. Previous FAILs unchanged.

architecture.trainable: only 8 head codes; shared QKV are physically stored frozen buffers in this particular mechanism study

storage_codec.code_quantization: uniform periodic angle map over [-pi,pi]; 32-bit codes stored as raw binary32
storage_codec.pack: bit-pack all 2H head codes into one contiguous stream; one physical shared QKV bank; no virtual QKV matrices serialized
storage_codec.program_charge: report separate source-code bytes as non-amortized upper bound. Raw codec bytes exclude library/program dependency and allocator metadata.

comparators: native independent QKV for each head, compact same-precision raw bytes, NOT capacity-equal
native folded linear Q/V right projections plus shared K, same function and same binary coding
shared QKV without View, 0 head code
existing equal-8-scalar gain control from original MA-1162 results
metrics: compact payload length by actual bytes buffer + checksum
full precision student vs decoded codec output MSE
physical and logical weight count separately
KV canonical vs 4 materialized head historical cache theoretical bytes

fixed_primary_candidate.selection_basis: development-only smallest code width passing BOTH aligned teacher families held-out MSE <1e-5; FP16 physical code was smaller than FP32

gates.quality: primary candidate MSE <1e-5 versus own aligned teacher in BOTH linear and nonlinear families for all six world-by-seed pairs per family
gates.head_difference: pairwise Attention KL >1e-4 on both aligned teacher families
gates.storage: primary model payload < same-precision full native QKV-head raw payload in all aligned rows; report source program separately
gates.off_orbit: off-orbit independent dense head teacher error retained without reinterpretation; expected >1e-3
gates.native_exactness: only linear Mirror may be claimed foldable into native Q/output maps
gates.status: PASS for compact aligned mechanism only; never call general real LM compression validated by these tests

execution.backend: PyTorch 2.10.0+cpu float32 execution; serialized base float16 or float32; packed code quantization
execution.cpu: AMD EPYC 9V74 virtual, clock not controlled
execution.fresh_trials: 3 worlds x 2 init seeds x 3 teacher families x 2 base precisions x 4 code precisions =144 rows, no exclusions

limitations: aligned teachers generated from same Mirror family; no real language NLL
nonlinear output View is not functionally equivalent to linear native folded Q/V
negative off-orbit teacher is deliberately outside Mirror manifold
actual runtime code and precision-specific kernels not included in tiny payload
canonical cache requires identical producer/hidden states and provenance
logical MHA here excludes learned Wout and higher-layer cache interactions
